After the Separation Date, your base salary shall be adjusted by the compensation committee of New Aerospace&#8217;s Board of Directors from time to time.  Adjustments are based on your performance and other relevant factors.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Annual Incentive Compensation Opportunity From New Aerospace&#58;  </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">As of the Separation Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">, your target incentive compensation opportunity with New Aerospace will be 80% of your annual cash base salary earnings during the year.  For the calendar year that contains the Separation Date, you will be eligible for an incentive compensation award from New Aerospace for post-Separation Date earnings.  New Aerospace incentive compensation awards are paid in the first quarter of the following year.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Pre-Separation Date Annual Incentive Compensation Opportunity&#58;  </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You will continue to be eligible to receive an incentive compensation award for your services with Honeywell up through the Separation Date.  Such award shall be based on your pre-Separation Date cash base salary earnings and incentive plan target percentage with Honeywell for the pre-separation period and shall be payable in the first quarter of the following year.  Honeywell retains the right to assign the related payment obligation to New Aerospace.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.008em;line-height:120%">Annual Long-Term Incentive Awards From New Aerospace&#58;  </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-0.008em;line-height:120%">After the Separation Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-0.008em;line-height:120%">, you will be eligible to receive annual long-term incentive (&#8220;LTI&#8221;) awards from New Aerospace consisting of stock options, restricted stock units, performance stock units or cash awards, or some combination thereof, as determined by New Aerospace in its sole discretion.
